Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The farm paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and launched a fundraising campaign. The story also noted that city sources provided about half of the farm’s funding the previous year, and that the Human Services Agency approved a grant extension through June 2026.
